pages.title: Saja Boys Group Pose on Stage Coloring Page
pages.description: The Saja Boys strike a group pose on stage in this printable coloring page, with three members standing behind two crouching figures on the steps. A finger heart, peace sign, and relaxed hand gestures distinguish their poses. Overhead spotlights, side lighting towers, and floor monitors surround their layered outfits and chunky shoes.

pages.title: Saja Boys Soda Pop Stage Performance Coloring Page
pages.description: The Saja Boys perform Soda Pop in this printable coloring page, wearing headset microphones as they hold an arrangement of standing and crouching stage poses. The central singer reaches toward the viewer while the others gesture around him. Jackets, waist chains, sneakers, and beams from overhead lights fill this detailed group coloring sheet.

pages.title: Saja Boys Your Idol Stage Performance Coloring Page
pages.description: The Saja Boys perform Your Idol on a stepped stage in this printable coloring page, dressed in long coats with decorative belts, chains, and tassels. The center member extends an open hand while two others kneel in front. Curtains, tall background panels, and a large circular arch frame the five performers.

pages.title: Saja Boys in Demon Forms During Your Idol Coloring Page
pages.description: The Saja Boys appear in their demon forms during Your Idol in this printable coloring page, posing together in flowing robes and wide-brimmed hats. Pointed ears, sharp nails, and facial markings distinguish the transformed members. Hanging hat beads, tied waist cords, broad sleeves, and curling smoke shapes provide many separate details around the group.

pages.title: Saja Boys in Human Idol Forms Coloring Page
pages.description: The Saja Boys pose in their human idol forms in this printable coloring page, combining three standing figures with two seated members in the foreground. Their casual jackets, hoodies, loose trousers, and sneakers contrast with smaller necklaces and earrings. An outstretched hand and a peace sign give the portrait its friendly stage-photo feel.

pages.title: Saja Boys Logo Coloring Page
pages.description: The Saja Boys logo rises behind five character portraits in this printable coloring page, combining an oversized intertwined monogram with curved accents and four-pointed sparkles. One member reaches forward at the bottom while the others overlap above him. Broad logo outlines, layered hairstyles, jacket collars, and jewelry create a mix of large and small coloring spaces.

pages.title: Saja Boys Walking Together in the Street Coloring Page
pages.description: The Saja Boys walk together along a city street in this printable coloring page, wearing casual layers and sneakers beneath trees and curved street lamps. One member makes a peace sign while another rests his arm across a companion's shoulders. Shopfront windows, trouser pockets, chains, and varied hairstyles add detail to the relaxed group outing.

pages.title: Saja Boys Drinking Tea Together Coloring Page
pages.description: The Saja Boys drink tea together in this printable coloring page, gathering around a round table with matching cups held near their smiling faces. A large teapot, saucers, a plate of small treats, and a flower-filled vase cover the tabletop. Their relaxed poses and layered shirts keep the tea-party scene focused on the five friends.

pages.title: Saja Boys Watching a Tablet Together Coloring Page
pages.description: The Saja Boys watch a tablet together in this printable coloring page, clustering around the seated member who holds the device horizontally in both hands. One companion points toward the screen while others lean in with smiles. Hooded tops, shirt collars, a cap, and lace-up sneakers fill the close group composition.

pages.title: Saja Boys During the Spicy Challenge Coloring Page
pages.description: The Saja Boys take on a spicy challenge in this printable coloring page, reacting with sweat drops, puffed cheeks, and open mouths while holding noodles with chopsticks. Bowls line the table beside peppers and side dishes. Wavy heat marks above the group reinforce the scene, with varied expressions giving each member a distinct reaction.

pages.title: Saja Boys Confronting Huntr/x at the Bathhouse Coloring Page
pages.description: The Saja Boys confront Huntr/x at the bathhouse in this printable coloring page, with the two groups facing each other beside a steaming pool. Folded arms and stern expressions emphasize their standoff. Towels, wooden buckets, hanging lanterns, and a curtain bearing a hot-spring symbol establish the bathhouse setting around the eight characters.

pages.title: Saja Boys Facing Huntr/x at the Show Coloring Page
pages.description: The Saja Boys face Huntr/x at a show in this printable coloring page, forming opposing lines across a stage beneath angled beams from concert lights. The five boys stand on the left and the three girls on the right. Steps, floor monitors, and audience members waving light sticks frame their tense group encounter.

pages.title: Saja Boys with Gwi-ma Coloring Page
pages.description: The Saja Boys pose with Gwi-ma looming behind them in this printable coloring page, his wide hat, pointed ears, sharp grin, and clawed hands filling the upper half. The five idols overlap in front, with the central member making a finger heart. Flowing hair and robe shapes contrast with their modern jackets and necklaces.

pages.title: Saja Boys Synchronized Dance on a Concert Stage Coloring Page
pages.description: The Saja Boys perform a synchronized dance on a concert stage in this printable coloring page, each raising one arm overhead and extending the other forward. Their wide stances repeat across the five-member formation. Layered jackets, loose trousers, waist chains, steps, and a surrounding frame of stage lights add structure to the performance.

pages.title: Saja Boys Standing Together in Idol Outfits Coloring Page
pages.description: The Saja Boys gather in ornate idol outfits in this printable coloring page, posing with three members upright and two crouching at the front of the group. Shoulder tassels, decorative chains, pendants, and jacket buttons supply fine costume details. The central figure reaches forward, surrounded by broad trouser panels and tall buckled boots.

pages.title: Saja Boys Close-up Portrait Collage Coloring Page
pages.description: The Saja Boys appear in a close-up portrait collage in this printable coloring page, with five overlapping faces showing smiles, a peace sign, and relaxed hand poses. Distinct swept fringes, a brimmed hat, earrings, and necklaces separate the portraits. Large sections of hair and clothing surround the smaller facial features.

pages.title: Jinu Leading the Saja Boys Concert Coloring Page
pages.description: Jinu leads the Saja Boys concert in this printable coloring page, singing into a handheld microphone while reaching an open hand toward the audience below. Four bandmates pose behind him beneath trusses and spotlights. Chains hang from his jacket and belt, while raised light sticks and a hand-heart shape fill the foreground crowd.

pages.title: Jinu Saja Boys Demon Form with Korean Hat Coloring Page
pages.description: Jinu wears a Korean hat in his Saja Boys demon form in this printable coloring page, extending one clawed hand as curling wisps surround his flowing robes. Beaded hat strings descend beside his marked face, and a tasseled ornament hangs from his tied belt. Broad sleeves and overlapping fabric panels dominate the full-length portrait.

pages.title: Jinu Saja Boys Singing on Stage Coloring Page
pages.description: Jinu sings on stage in this printable coloring page, holding a microphone near his mouth and reaching outward beneath four overhead spotlights mounted on a truss. His open jacket carries decorative chains, with another chain hanging from his belt. Stage steps and angular side panels frame the full-body performance pose.

pages.title: Jinu and Rumi Standing Together Coloring Page
pages.description: Jinu and Rumi stand together in this printable coloring page, smiling side by side as his arm rests around her shoulders and their free hands sit in pockets. Both wear casual jackets, cargo trousers, and sneakers. Rumi's long braid, Jinu's pendant, and the large pocket flaps give the two-character portrait distinctive details.

pages.title: Jinu and Rumi Fighting Together Coloring Page
pages.description: Jinu and Rumi fight together in this printable coloring page, standing back to back with raised swords and focused expressions as their coats and hair sweep outward. Rumi holds a curved blade across the foreground while Jinu extends his free hand. Braided hair, sword guards, belt chains, and boot laces add detail to the action pose.

pages.title: Jinu with Derpy Tiger and Sussie Bird Coloring Page
pages.description: Jinu sits with Derpy Tiger and Sussie Bird in this printable coloring page, resting his cheek on one hand while the tiger stretches across his lap. Sussie perches on his shoulder with wide eyes and an open beak. The tiger's stripes, oversized paws, curled tail, and playful tongue make the animal companions prominent.

pages.title: Baby Saja Soda Pop Dancing Pose Coloring Page
pages.description: Baby Saja strikes a Soda Pop dancing pose in this printable coloring page, leaning sideways with bent knees and a playful pointing gesture toward the viewer. His oversized head and small body give the character a chibi appearance. A loose jacket, side-striped trousers, and broad sneakers create clear clothing sections around the smiling face.

pages.title: Baby Saja Soda Pop Rap Performance Coloring Page
pages.description: Baby Saja delivers a Soda Pop rap performance in this printable coloring page, holding a microphone near his mouth and extending his other hand toward the audience. A large ring pendant hangs over his shirt, with a jacket and loose cargo trousers below. Speaker stacks and overhead spotlights frame the chibi performer.

pages.title: Baby Saja Spicy Challenge Winner Coloring Page
pages.description: Baby Saja celebrates as the spicy challenge winner in this printable coloring page, raising a pepper-emblem trophy while standing on a podium decorated with a star. pages.title: Mystery Saja Soda Pop Performance Coloring Page

pages.title: Romance Saja Soda Pop Stage Pose Coloring Page

pages.title: Romance Saja Elegant Idol Pose Coloring Page

pages.title: Abby Saja Stylish Idol Pose Coloring Page
